import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from fin_skills.algorithms import run

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices for splits
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors
    
    # Calculate daily returns
    daily_returns = adjusted_prices.pct_change().dropna()
    
    # Calculate the momentum signal
    momentum = np.sign(daily_returns.shift(-21)) * np.minimum(1, 0.10 / (daily_returns.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252)))
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(np.zeros_like(momentum), index=momentum.index, columns=momentum.columns)
    
    # Set non-zero weights starting from row 21
    weights.iloc[21:] = momentum.iloc[21:]
    
    # Normalize weights to sum to 1 per row
    weights /= weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    
    return weights
